title: Cancelled Pharmaceutical Products
description: Complete list of pharmaceutical products with registrations cancelled by the Drug Control Authority. The table provides a preview of the dataset using 10 records as a sample.

fields.name: reg_no
fields.title: Registration Number
fields.description: [String] Unique identifier for the product's registration

fields.name: holder
fields.title: Holder
fields.description: [String] Company or entity holding the registration

fields.name: manufacturer
fields.title: Manufacturer
fields.description: [String] Name of the manufacturer of the product

fields.name: date_reg
fields.title: Registration Date
fields.description: [Date] Date when the product was registered in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: date_end
fields.title: Expiry Date
fields.description: [Date] Date when the product's cancellation took or takes effect in YYYY-MM-DD format

methodology: In accordance with the Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984, all pharmaceutical, health and personal care products marketed in Malaysia must be registered and approved by the Drug Control Authority (DCA). In the present day, registrations are conducted using the QUEST3+ system, which is the administrative system used by NPRA to enable the online management of product registrations, variations, licensing, market sampling, renewal and others. This dataset is an exact copy of the administrative record of products with cancelled registrations, with any columns containing personal data excluded.
caveat: Although this data represents administrative records, it nevertheless remains a static dataset which is updated once per day, rather than in real time. As such, this dataset should not be used as the basis for any legal action. Any queries on enforcement of the relevant laws of Malaysia should always be referred to the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA).
